resources.string: Choose two teams or everyone for themselves, how long each turn lasts and how many rounds to play.
Pick a card level for each team: little kids get easy picture cards, grown-ups get harder ones.
Pass the device to the actor. They hold the pad to start and see the card while everyone else looks away.
Act it out without talking. Tap Correct when the team guesses it, or Skip for a new card (three skips each turn).
Correct cards score points for the actor\'s team. The team with the most points after the last round wins.
Charades began as a parlour game in 18th-century France, where players acted out one syllable at a time.
